content.summary: Analog chipmaker Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 2% year on year to $1.14 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.35 per share was 4.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
